channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Blake | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Blake from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Steve Blake
item.description:
Apparently, the two guards butted heads in the middle of one of their training sessions, which Arenas recalled on his No Chill Podcast:

“During practice, I elbowed Steve Blake and he swung at me. I was like, ‘Damn, wait hold on.’ Oh, really? Did the white boy just throw a punch at me? Is that how we’re working here, right?”

Gilbert Arenas on Steve Blake, Oct 29, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Bob Myers on Steve Blake
item.description:
Rusty Simmons:Bob Myers on Steve Blake:

“He’s a tough player, he’s a good player & he’s smart. … “When you give him the ball, you know you can trust him.”

Bob Myers on Steve Blake, Feb 20, 2014. Source: Twitter @Rusty_SFChron.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Steve Blake
item.description:
Leila Rahimi:Dwight Howard on game-winning 3 by Steve Blake last time vs Lakers:

“I was pissed off. I wanted to beat those guys, but he hit a tough shot”

Dwight Howard on Steve Blake, Jan 7, 2014. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Lance Jackson on Steve Blake
item.description:
What’s your version of what happened Friday night at the game?:Lance Jackson:

“Well, first of all, I want to say I have the utmost respect for the game, the Lakers organization and most importantly the players. I have been going to games my entire life and we’re passionate fans, but I have never and would never ever use profanity towards any player, or anyone for that matter. With that being said, we’re really just trying to encourage Steve Blake and get him going. I told him to knock down a shot and it was just the heat of the moment type of thing. He’s a great guy and, like I said, just heat of the moment and he just got upset.”

Lance Jackson on Steve Blake, Nov 8, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Mike Brown on Steve Blake
item.description:
“Same with Steve [Blake], he can play the two also. I look at them as guards, rather than just point guards.”

Mike Brown on Steve Blake, Oct 13, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: George Karl on Steve Blake
item.description:
Mike Trudell:George Karl:

“I hate Steve Blake tonight, but I love him as a player.”

George Karl on Steve Blake, May 13, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Shannon Brown on Steve Blake
item.description:
Lakers guardSteve Blake told team player representative Shannon Brown prior to Monday's meeting that he was in favor of accepting a deal that would have included a 50-50 split of basketball related income and still allowed for a 72-game season if approved by the union this week.

“I spoke to (Blake) and he was one of the guys who wanted to take the deal,”

Shannon Brown on Steve Blake, Nov 16, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
